llm_response.reason: The website claims to be a cryptocurrency exchange but has only a vague homepage slogan and lacks all standard navigational hyperlinks or pages (About, Contact, Legal, Terms, FAQ). Domain registration is recent with full privacy shield. There is no verifiable company information, no common payment or customer support details, and no transparency on operations. SSL certificate issues present additional risk. All these align with scam criteria: ambiguous privacy/customer information, unusual/lacking contact details, opaque business identity, absence of standard e-commerce features, and security/jurisdictional concerns.
